course.title: Lithuanian 30-Day A1/A2 Intensive Syllabus
design_principles: Core function words are taught before topic-heavy vocabulary.
Questions, sentences, and survival phrases are prioritised before long noun lists.
Source lesson order is retained as metadata but not used as the course order.
Mastery is tracked from 1 to 10 per item.
Dashboard buckets are based on item mastery: weak, medium, strong, mastered.
